steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ's Responses tab, which is the required starting screen.
Enable the required eRFX project setting before accessing the prepared RFQ.
Open the Reject Bid pop-up for the submitted response.
Enter the requested rejection reason; the exact field label is not confirmed by the catalog.
Cancel the rejection instead of submitting it.
Verify both submitted vendor responses remain visible after cancellation.
Verify the Reject action remains available, indicating the bid was not rejected.
